philosophy: Tint detects observable structural and linguistic patterns. It does not assert intent. It does not call anything fake. Weights are starting heuristics, not truth. Fork and disagree.

orange.label: Attention-optimized
orange.feeling: This space wants my nervous system.

red.label: Coercive pressure
red.feeling: Something here is trying to control me.

intensity_rule: hue = atmosphere type. opacity / saturation = intensity. A page is never binary — it is a spectrum.

threshold.rationale: Below 0.25 the page reads as neutral. Tint should highlight ~20% of strongest signals, not 100% of everything.

signals.description: Dense emotional intensifiers. Designed to activate.
patterns: share imperatives (share this, spread the word)
we/us co-occurring with they/them in close range

signals.description: Engagement cues compete for focus. Reaction becomes content.

patterns: scarcity cues (only N left, limited time)
urgency imperatives (act now, before it's gone)
filler phrases (in today's fast-paced world, game-changer)
SEO listicle title pattern (10 things X in 2026)
